{{Name|Artifact Trove|3.6%}}{{Name|Mystery Box}}{{Name|Golden Mystery Box}} |season = Fall |sellprice = 2500 |quality = false |edibility = -300 }} The '''Golden Pumpkin''' is an item that can be obtained every other year during the [[Spirit's Eve]] [[Festivals|Festival]] by [[Spirit's Eve#Surviving the Haunted Maze|completing the maze]]. It can also be found in [[Artifact Trove]]s (3.7% chance), [[Mystery Box]]es, and [[Golden Mystery Box]]es. It can be sold through the [[Shipping|Shipping Bin]] for {{Price|2500}}. Despite its description, it has two other uses: *It can be gifted as a [[Friendship#Universal Loves|universally loved gift]]. *It can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] into a [[Witch Hat]] at the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|sewing machine at Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine|sewing machine]] gifted by [[Emily]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== The Golden Pumpkin is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== A Golden Pumpkin is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Witch Hat|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== The Golden Pumpkin is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Notes== The Golden Pumpkin must be sold at the [[Shipping|Shipping Bin]] on [[The Farm|the farm]], as [[Pierre]] will not buy it. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.3.27|Changed from universally hated gift to universally loved gift.}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source.
